paper.title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution
paper.central_claim: 经验复用的核心问题不是提供更多经验，而是把经验编码成紧凑、面向控制、可演化的对象：紧凑 Gene（~230 令牌）比文档式 Skill（~2,500 令牌）更适合作测试时控制，更适合作为累积经验的载体；基因演化系统在 CritPt 上显著优于配对基座。
paper.scope_note: B类：经验表示/技能包+保留协议；评价静态注入探针与外部演化引擎，不虚构闭环收益。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref null: subagent dispatched via claude-kimi model type; no run receipt exposed to the worker (not probed). Score arithmetic: coverage is a 0..1 fraction; lower/upper are 0..100.

evidence.quote: We find that documentation-oriented Skill packages provide unstable control: their useful signal is sparse, and expanding a compact experience object into a fuller documentation package often fails to help and can degrade the overall average.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者结论一：全文档式 Skill 作为测试时控制不稳定。

evidence.quote: On CritPt, gene-evolved systems improve over their paired base models from 9.1% to 18.57% and from 17.7% to 27.14%.
evidence.support_explanation: 演化系统在 CritPt 的结果（作者报告）。

evidence.quote: These results suggest that the core problem in experience reuse is not how to supply more experience, but how to encode experience as a compact, control-oriented, evolution-ready object.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张。

evidence.quote: more complete and structured experience representations should be more beneficial for subsequent task solving.
evidence.support_explanation: 被检验的隐含前提。

evidence.quote: Our point of departure is to test this assumption directly.
evidence.support_explanation: 论文自述起点为检验该前提。

evidence.quote: a strategy gene is not merely a compressed version of a procedural skill, but a different abstraction of reusable experience.
evidence.support_explanation: Gene 与 Skill 的定位。

evidence.quote: A strategy gene is obtained by a distillation map
evidence.support_explanation: Gene 由映射 ψ 从 Skill 或轨迹得到；正文未说明 ψ 由谁/如何实现。

evidence.quote: All experiments use two fixed Gemini models, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (Pro) and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Preview (Flash), and comprise 4,590 retained trials in total.
evidence.support_explanation: 实验规模；“retained trials”的筛除规则未给。

evidence.quote: all derived from the same per-scenario experience source.
evidence.support_explanation: Gene/Skill/无指导来自同一场景级经验来源；该来源是否包含该场景的测试信息未说明。
无指导基线(Pro 60.1/Flash 41.8/Avg 51.0)。
Gene：Pro 不变、Flash +6.4，Avg +3.0。

evidence.quote: Its benefit is therefore not robust at the benchmark level, and the full documentation package does not function as a reliable test-time control interface.
evidence.support_explanation: Skill 在 Flash +7.2 但 Pro −9.4。
同一“无指导”基线在不同表中 Pro 60.1% 与 57.9% 不同：运行间波动约 2pp，与多数效应同量级。

evidence.quote: Skill-Workflow is the only clearly useful component, whereas Skill-Overview is strongly harmful, and the full Skill package remains below the no-guidance baseline.
evidence.support_explanation: Skill 分节拆解。

evidence.quote: Under matched budget, shortened Skill fragments become markedly more competitive.
evidence.support_explanation: 匹配预算后差距缩小，但仍低于 Gene。

evidence.quote: Wrong algorithm 49.6% 47.9% 48.8%
evidence.support_explanation: 内容破坏（错误算法）降到 48.8%，低于无指导 51.0%。

evidence.quote: Stale paradigm 59.9% 53.4% 56.6%
evidence.support_explanation: “过时范式”(56.6%)反而高于干净 Gene(54.0%)。

evidence.quote: Two complementary Gene s 45.5% 44.3% 44.9% -6.1
evidence.support_explanation: 两个互补 Gene 比无指导低 6.1pp。
失败历史附加在 Gene 上削弱。

evidence.quote: Because the two conditions contain the same underlying experience, the gap cannot be explained by content availability or token count.
evidence.support_explanation: 结构 vs 摊平文本的对照（Gene 摊平为 −0.5）。

evidence.quote: Failure history is most effective when distilled into standalone warnings.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅失败警告 +4.6pp，但基线与表1不同。

evidence.quote: We view the earlier version as memory-grounded evolution: its gains mainly come from consolidating prior failures, execution traces, and corrective experience into reusable control units.
evidence.support_explanation: CritPt 版本 A 描述。

evidence.quote: Across 70 70 tasks, the system uses 210 210 gene slots and 36 36 unique gene IDs
evidence.support_explanation: 版本 B：基因池以 arXiv 导出基因为主，是否在被测任务上演化/来源未说明。

evidence.quote: Validated capability is written back into the protocolized repository as a new or revised gene, and the corresponding capsule and event records are updated.
evidence.support_explanation: GEP 的 solidify 步骤描述。

evidence.quote: The candidate is executed in a sandbox or otherwise checked against validation hooks. Only assets that satisfy the required criteria are eligible for persistence.
evidence.support_explanation: GEP 的 validate 门控描述，未评估其效果。

evidence.quote: Reasoning-token costs could not be reliably recovered from our logs, so this number should be viewed as an input/output-only estimate.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本比较不含推理令牌。

evidence.quote: 2. Convert min_distance into sample-index units before peak detection
evidence.support_explanation: Gene 示例内容高度针对该场景的已知失败点。

evidence.quote: Under checkpoint-based evaluation, these differences affect not only whether the final program fully passes, but also which sub-tasks succeed.
evidence.support_explanation: 评测是该场景的检查点脚本，Gene 内容与检查点直接相关。

evidence.quote: This study includes 4,590 retained trials over 45 scientific scenarios.
evidence.support_explanation: 45 场景；每格重复数未说明。

evidence.quote: This beta technical report asks how reusable experience should be represented
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自称 beta 技术报告。

evidence.quote: Evolver organizes self-evolution around structured Genes, accumulates causal experience through memory, and solidifies successful updates through validation-governed evolution events.
evidence.support_explanation: CritPt 使用外部 Evolver 引擎，论文未给其实验内部细节。

signatures.object: 测试时注入的经验对象：Skill(~2,500 令牌文档包) vs Gene(~230 令牌：keywords/summary/strategy/AVOID)
signatures.information: 场景级经验来源；任务描述单独走 contents，经验走 systemInstruction；Gemini 3.1 Pro/Flash-Lite 固定模型
signatures.operation: 把同一来源经验表示为不同对象（Gene、Skill、Skill 分节、预算匹配片段、扰动版、摊平文本）并注入
signatures.output: 沙箱运行的代码在检查点上的通过率
signatures.persistence: 静态对象；失败历史探针手工附加
signatures.failure_boundary: 组合多个 Gene 会降低；内容错误有害；来源可能含场景信息

signatures.object: GEP 协议：gene/capsule/event 三类对象与 scan→signal→intent→mutate→validate→solidify 循环
signatures.information: 运行轨迹、日志、失败信号；沙箱与验证钩子
signatures.operation: 由信号触发候选基因的变异，验证后写回并记录不可变事件
signatures.conditions: Evolver 引擎 + OpenClaw 宿主；两版各运行约 2 天
signatures.selection_rule: 验证钩子通过才可持久化（文字描述，无评估）
signatures.persistence: 基因/胶囊库 + 事件日志（含 asset_id 哈希）
signatures.later_use: 后续任务按信号匹配基因
signatures.failure_boundary: 无基因关闭消融、无其他记忆机制对照、基座数字来源未说明

gap.author_gap: ProcMEM、MemSkill、Memento-Skills、CoWork-X 等隐含“更完整、更结构化的经验表示更有益”，而经验应如何表示才能作为有效的测试时控制信号未被检验。
gap.checked_gap: 问题真实且贴近留存对象（技能/经验的形态）；但最近邻不仅有长文档 Skill，也有已经紧凑的洞见/备忘单(ExpeL、Dynamic Cheatsheet、ReasoningBank)；论文用自己的 Skill 实例作对照，并未用这些现成紧凑表示对比，gap 的“残余”半证实。
gap.lineage: 祖先：Reflexion/ExpeL 式文字经验、Voyager 式技能库；最近邻：ProcMEM、MemSkill、Memento-Skills、CoWork-X、Dynamic Cheatsheet、ReasoningBank。均为论文自述，本地无固定副本。

claims.text: 紧凑 Gene 比全文 Skill 更适合作测试时控制（Gene +3.0pp；Skill −1.1pp）
claims.setting: 45 场景，Gemini 3.1 Pro/Flash-Lite，检查点通过率
claims.baseline_control: 无指导；Skill；Skill 分节；预算匹配片段
claims.selection_vs_test: 场景级经验与被测场景同一场景；未说明排除
claims.result_denominator: 4,590 retained trials；每格重复数与筛除未说明
claims.allowed_conclusion: Gene 在 Pro 上不变、在 Flash 上提升；平均优势依赖 Pro 的 Skill 下降；增益与噪声同量级。

claims.text: Gene 对结构扰动稳健、对内容错误敏感
claims.setting: 错误算法/领域、倒置优先级、过度约束、过时范式
claims.allowed_conclusion: 错误内容有害；过时范式不更差（甚至更高）说明增益可能来自“框定任务”而非精确策略。

claims.text: Gene 是更好的经验累积载体，应“选择性压缩”失败历史
claims.setting: Gene/Skill/自由文本+失败历史；结构 vs 摊平；失败警告
claims.allowed_conclusion: 静态附加失败文本会稀释；证据不足以说明演化回路中的累积。

claims.text: 基因演化系统在 CritPt 上显著提升
claims.selection_vs_test: 未说明演化是否见到被测任务
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告的系统级提升；不能归因于 Gene 表示（无关闭/替代对照）。

assessment.evidence_level_note: 探针是对静态经验对象的比较；CritPt 缺少留存机制的因果对照与留出说明，故未达 retained。
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 在 45 个科学代码场景、两个 Gemini 模型上，为同一场景注入 230 令牌的结构化策略对象，不劣于/优于 2,500 令牌的文档式 Skill（均值差 4.1pp 与噪声同量级）；表示重要性成立，演化收益未归因。
unresolved: CritPt 基座数字来源与归因

G.reason: 检验“更完整更好”的前提有价值，但对最近邻紧凑经验系统比较不足，Skill 对照由作者自己实例化。

M.reason: 表示重要的因果故事靠探针支撑，“演化就绪”基本是修辞；Gene 的获取方法未交代。

X.reason: 静态探针协议清楚；GEP 与 Evolver 的留存/回退/过期只有概念描述，无执行细节或评估。

E.measurement.reason: 检查点脚本是确定性验证器，但为作者自建 Gene-Bench；“retained trials”筛除未明；CritPt 基座数字来源不清。

E.causality.reason: 预算匹配、摊平、内容破坏是不错的对照，效应仅 1–3pp 且噪声同量级；CritPt 无关闭对照。

E.holdout.reason: 经验与被测场景一一对应，可能含针对检查点的提示；未测不相交任务复用；CritPt 演化来源不明。

E.statistics.reason: 全文无种子、方差、CI；“retained trials”剔除规则未给；两表无指导基线不同本身显示噪声。

E.cost.reason: 给出提示长度(230 vs 2,500)与预算匹配片段；蒸馏与两天演化成本缺失，CritPt 成本不含推理令牌。

status_reason: 全文含附录已读；不足为 Gene 来源/泄漏、重复与统计、CritPt 归因。
rationale: beta 技术报告：表示形态实验有益，但同场景来源可能泄漏、效应与噪声同量级、无统计；演化声称（CritPt）缺因果对照与成本。
